intro_1.text: Our story begins in the Vaults of Hush, where it is very, very important to be quiet. Luckily, our heroine Mouse is the quietest thief alive. And I am Percival, her narrator.

oops0_1.text: ...Did he hear me? Oh dear. Anyone inside my ring hears every word, I'm afraid. I'll try to keep it down.

goal1_1.text: Now then. See that lever by the gate? Give it a pull. I'll tell everyone, of course. I can't help it. It's my job.

t_ring_1.text: See that ring? That's how far I carry. Anyone standing in it hears me. I'm told it's a gift.

t_nod_1.text: That's Nod. Stand by the lever and my ring will show. If he's inside it when I speak, he'll hear. So wait till he wanders off.

t_stilts_1.text: Stilts is guarding the stairs. From the wrong side, bless him. Get me talking about those pots, and he'll go and have a look.

t_gord_1.text: Gord has the archive key on his belt. Sneak up behind him and help yourself. Then get well clear before I mention it. I will mention it.

restart_1.text: From the top! Our story begins, once again, in the Vaults of Hush.

restart_2.text: Take two. Mouse creeps in. I clear my throat.

restart_3.text: Let's try that again. With feeling.

tlever0_1.text: A lever. Pulled. A gate, going up. I'm saying it ever so quietly.

tlever1_1.text: She pulls the lever, and the gate grinds open. What a lovely noise.

tlever1_2.text: A lever, pulled! A gate, rising! I do love a gate.

tlever2_1.text: The lever! The gate! Up it goes! Ooh, here we go!

tlever3_1.text: SHE PULLED THE LEVER! THE GATE IS GOING UP! EVERYBODY!

pick0_1.text: She's got the key. I'm saying nothing. I am saying so very little.

pick0_2.text: A pocket. Picked. Mm. Mm-hm. Nothing to see here.

pick1_1.text: And with nimble fingers, she lifts the key from his belt. Nicely done.

pick1_2.text: A pocket, picked! I do enjoy a bit of light larceny.

pick1_3.text: She's got his key. He hasn't noticed. Bless him.

pick2_1.text: She picked his pocket! Right off his belt! Ooh, I'm tingling!

pick2_2.text: Did you see that? In and out, like a draught under a door!

pick2_3.text: She's got it! She's actually got it!

pick3_1.text: SHE HAS PICKED HIS POCKET! RIGHT BEHIND HIM! HE HAS NO IDEA!

pick3_2.text: A PICKPOCKET! A DARING, DASHING PICKPOCKET!

pick3_3.text: THE KEY! SHE TOOK THE KEY! FROM HIS ACTUAL POCKET!

unlock0_1.text: The door's open. Shh. I'm whispering. Look at me, whispering.

unlock1_1.text: The key turns, the lock clicks, and the archive door creaks open.

unlock2_1.text: It opens! The archive door is open! Onward, into the dark!

unlock2_2.text: Oh, what a door! What a lovely, unlocked door!

unlock3_1.text: THE DOOR IS UNLOCKED! EVERYBODY! THE ARCHIVE IS OPEN!

unlock3_2.text: SHE'S IN! THE ARCHIVE DOOR IS OPEN! SHE'S IN!

lever0_1.text: A lever. Pulled. I want to shout about it. I won't.

lever0_2.text: Somewhere, a gate is going up. I'm not even going to mention it.

lever1_1.text: She heaves the lever, and far away, the vault gate grinds open.

lever1_2.text: Levers! The dungeon's doorbell. The vault gate is open now.

lever2_1.text: The lever! The gate! The vault is open! Ooh, it's all coming together!

lever2_2.text: The gate is going up! Magnificent old machinery!

lever3_1.text: SHE PULLED THE LEVER! THE VAULT IS OPEN! THE VAULT IS OPEN!

lever3_2.text: THE GATE IS UP! NOTHING CAN STOP HER NOW! EXCEPT THE GUARDS!

idol0_1.text: She has the idol. I'm being so quiet. So, so quiet. Mmmph.

idol0_2.text: The Idol of Silence. I am staying calm. I am staying very calm.

idol1_1.text: And there it is. The Idol of Silence, in her little hands. Lovely.

idol1_2.text: She takes the idol. What a moment. What a quiet, sensible moment.

idol2_1.text: She has the idol! Oh my word! She has the Idol of Silence!

idol2_2.text: The idol! It's hers! I think I'm going to faint!

idol3_1.text: SHE HAS THE IDOL! SHE HAS THE IDOL OF SILENCE! EVERYONE! SHE HAS IT!

idol3_2.text: THE IDOL IS OURS! THIS IS THE GREATEST MOMENT IN THE HISTORY OF NARRATION!

roll_a0_1.text: Ooh. The Roll of the Caught. Every thief they ever nabbed down here.

roll_a1_1.text: Ah, the Roll of the Caught! Every thief they ever nabbed down here, carved in stone.

roll_a2_1.text: The Roll of the Caught! Every thief they ever caught! Carved in stone!

roll_a3_1.text: THE ROLL OF THE CAUGHT! EVERY THIEF THEY EVER CAUGHT!

roll_b0_1.text: Sticky Nell. Barnaby Quill. Both Fenwick twins. One of them twice.

roll_b1_1.text: Sticky Nell. Barnaby Quill. Both Fenwick twins. One of them twice.

roll_b2_1.text: Sticky Nell! Barnaby Quill! Both Fenwick twins! One of them twice!

roll_b3_1.text: STICKY NELL! BARNABY QUILL! BOTH FENWICK TWINS! ONE OF THEM TWICE!

roll_c0_1.text: And at the bottom, a nice blank space. About Mouse-sized.

roll_c1_1.text: And at the bottom, a nice blank space. Freshly chiselled. About Mouse-sized.

roll_c2_1.text: And a blank space at the bottom! Freshly chiselled! Mouse-sized!

roll_c3_1.text: AND A BLANK SPACE AT THE BOTTOM! IT'S MOUSE-SIZED!

book_a0_1.text: Ooh, the visitors' book. Nobody has signed it in eleven years.

book_a1_1.text: Ooh, the visitors' book! Do sign in, Mouse. Nobody has in eleven years.

book_a2_1.text: The visitors' book! Sign in, Mouse! Nobody's signed it in eleven years!

book_a3_1.text: THE VISITORS' BOOK! SIGN IN, MOUSE! SIGN IN!

book_b0_1.text: Wait, here's one. Gord. And a little drawing of a horse.

book_b1_1.text: Oh, wait, here's one. Gord. And a little drawing of a horse.

book_b2_1.text: Here's one! Gord! He drew a horse!

book_b3_1.text: GORD! GORD SIGNED IT! HE DREW A HORSE!

book_c0_1.text: Lovely horse. Very long legs. The vault lever is in here somewhere.

book_c1_1.text: Lovely horse. Very long legs. Anyway. The vault lever is somewhere in here.

book_c2_1.text: What a horse! Anyway! The lever! It's in here somewhere!

book_c3_1.text: WHAT A HORSE! AND THE LEVER IS IN HERE SOMEWHERE! FIND THE LEVER!

h_door0_1.text: Locked. Gord has the key. The big one, with the lantern.

h_gate0_1.text: The vault gate. Shut tight. There must be a lever somewhere. The archive, perhaps.

h_grate0_1.text: A grate. Locked fast. A lever somewhere, I expect.

h_case0_1.text: Locked in its case. The vault guard has the case key. Of course he does.

h_rope0_1.text: The way out. But we can't leave without the idol. What sort of story would that be?

bore0_1.text: She examines it closely. It is exactly what it looks like.

bore0_2.text: Oh. She's looking at that. Lovely.

bore0_3.text: A fascinating object. If you're a very boring person.

bore0_4.text: She studies it. Every dull inch.

again0_1.text: She looks at it again. Still the same.

again0_2.text: Again? It hasn't changed. Nothing in here changes.

b_shelf_1.text: A book. A History of Beige, Volume Nine. She reads the index.

b_shelf_2.text: Gravel: A Life. Chapter one. Chapter two. Still gravel.

b_crate_1.text: A crate. Wooden. Contains more wood, probably.

b_barrel_1.text: A barrel. She knocks on it. Hollow. Like this moment.

b_table_1.text: A table. Two plates and a mug. Somebody had a very dull lunch.

b_chair_1.text: A chair. Four legs. She counts them twice to be sure.

b_urns_1.text: Some urns. Old, dusty, and full of more dust.

b_pots_1.text: Pots. Clay pots. One of them has a crack in it. Thrilling.

b_pots_2.text: A stack of pots. She counts them. Seven. No, eight.

b_sacks_1.text: Sacks. Of what? Flour, probably. Riveting.

b_desk_1.text: A desk. A quill. A form, half filled in. Name: Gerald. Reason for visit: none.

b_rack_1.text: Spears. Pointy. Tidy. Nobody has dusted them since the war.

rev_ghost_1.text: Not one guard heard a word. A ghost story. Nobody reads those.

rev_whisper_1.text: A quiet little tale. Mostly quiet. I did my very best.

rev_page_1.text: A page-turner! Guards everywhere! Three stars, at least.

rev_best_1.text: A bestseller! Shouting! Chases! I'd buy it twice!

spotted3_2.text: HE SEES HER! HE SEES HER!

spotted3_4.text: DISCOVERED! THIS IS THE BEST PART!

spotted3_5.text: OH NO! OH YES! OH NO!

spotted3_6.text: CAUGHT IN THE ACT! WELL, NEARLY CAUGHT! RUN!

chase3_4.text: DON'T LET HIM CATCH YOU! UNLESS IT'S DRAMATIC!

chase3_5.text: LOSE HIM, MOUSE! LOSE HIM IN THE SHADOWS!

lost0_1.text: She lost him. Phew. Phew phew phew.

lost1_1.text: Gone. He's lost her. My heart can't take much more of this.

lost2_1.text: She lost him! She actually lost him!

lost2_3.text: He can't find her! What a thief!

giveup0_1.text: And he gives up. Back to his rounds.

giveup1_1.text: He gives up. Back to his post.

giveup1_2.text: And he wanders off. Some guard.

giveup1_3.text: Oh. He's leaving. That's a shame. I mean, phew.

caught3_1.text: CAUGHT! Oh, what a finish! What a magnificent, terrible finish!

caught3_2.text: HE'S GOT HER! THE THIEF IS CAUGHT! I SAW IT ALL AND I SAID IT ALL!

caught3_3.text: Grabbed by the hood! Dragged off by the socks! What a story!

blame1_1.text: If only she had been quieter.

blame1_2.text: I really don't know how he heard her.

blame1_3.text: Shall we try again? I'll be quiet this time. I promise. Really.

win3_1.text: SHE DID IT! SHE ESCAPED WITH THE IDOL OF SILENCE!

win1_1.text: And as Mouse stepped into the daylight, the idol whispered one word. Shh. I didn't listen.

g_hear_2.text: Somebody's talking about pockets. I've got pockets.

g_hear_3.text: Is someone narrating? I hate it when someone's narrating.

g_hear_4.text: I heard that! Every word! Very descriptive!

s_hear_1.text: W-who's there? Is that a ghost? A posh ghost?

s_hear_2.text: Hello? Mister voice? Who are you talking about?

s_hear_3.text: Gah! The walls are commentating again!

s_hear_4.text: Th-that was a mustache voice. I know a mustache voice when I hear one.

g_giveup_1.text: Must've been the wind. A talking wind.

s_giveup_1.text: N-nobody here. Good. Very good. I'm leaving.

s_giveup_2.text: Just the voice again. Just the voice.

g_belt_1.text: My pocket? Where's my key? Where's my key!

g_belt_2.text: Was that about my belt? Somebody touched my belt.

g_door_1.text: The door? Who's been at the door?

s_door_1.text: Th-the door? Nobody's allowed in the archive!

s_lever_1.text: Who touched the lever? Levers are for grown-ups!

s_idol_1.text: The idol! Somebody's nicked the idol!

n_hear_2.text: Keep it down. Some of us are working.

n_giveup_1.text: Nobody. Back to work. By which I mean sleep.

n_caught_1.text: Got one. Can I go back to sleep now?

b_hear_1.text: Who's there? Forty years I've guarded this vault. Show yourself.

b_hear_3.text: I heard that. Somebody's describing things in my vault.

b_giveup_1.text: Forty years. Never a dull moment. Mostly dull moments.

b_caught_1.text: Got you. Forty years, and nobody gets past Bertram.

b_belt_1.text: My key? Where's my case key?

b_lever_1.text: The gate? Who's been at the gate?

b_idol_1.text: THE IDOL! WHO TOOK THE IDOL?

s_caught_1.text: I caught one! Mum will be so proud!
